projects.title: Transmission Project
projects.description: - Designed and built a compound gear transmission driven by a brushed DC motor to power a bicycle wheel, taking it from initial design through fabrication and final assembly.- Milled the acrylic walls and base, machined bearing press fit features on a lathe, dialed in fits by testing bore diameters in 0.001-inch increments, and assembled the complete transmission.- Optimized the gear ratio in MATLAB using power and speed equation sweeps, selecting a 5.76:1 gear ratio across two symmetric 2.4:1 stages, and calculated bearing bore positions and gear center distances to hold correct gear mesh alignment.

projects.title: Autonomous Robot Car
projects.description: - Built and tested the electro-mechanical system for a robot car, from concept to reality, to enable autonomous navigation, mapping, and path planning.- Integrated and calibrated sensors, motors, and microcontrollers into a ROS-based communication system and developed hysteresis-based algorithms for intersection, dead-end, and obstacle detection to enable real-time obstacle avoidance and dynamic rerouting.- Reduced navigation errors by 85% across repeated runs on complex tracks by developing Python scripts to automate testing, log data, and diagnose hardware-software behavior through root cause analysis.

projects.title: Beer Pong Robot
projects.description: Ping, Pong, Shots All Night Long!- Built a flywheel-based 2-DOF ball-launching mechanism with motor-driver and servo-angle control.- CAD-modeled and fabricated full mechanical system.- Tuned for repeatable, consistent firing and validated reliability through iterative testing.

projects.title: Object Detection Robot
projects.description: - Built a 2-axis object-tracking gimbal using manipulation via motor control and perception via computer vision to enable reliable, real-time target detection and tracking.- Developed a real-time HSV-based computer vision pipeline with noise filtering, contour extraction, and area gating to reliably detect and localize a target object.- Built a 2-axis pan–tilt motor control system using cubic-spline trajectory generation at 100 Hz, enabling smooth tracking and immediate response to key commands.- Designed and fabricated custom CAD components for mounting the motors and camera, ensuring structural alignment and low vibration.
